evidence: C1-C3 are stacked in a single column roughly 4-8mm left of U1 with an intervening pad row between them and the IC body, rather than each cap sitting immediately adjacent to the power pin it serves.
All six SPI/control ratsnest lines from the right-edge header J2 double back across the entire U1 footprint to pads on the IC's left side, so the SPI chain does not read in placement order.

Straight pad-to-pad lines from J1's RX-/RX+/TX pins visibly cross each other on the way to the termination passives, and the J2-to-U1 SPI bundle fans across the IC, forcing avoidable crossover traces.
There is no on-board protection or regulation stage; regulated 3V3 enters at header J3 and feeds the U1 load cluster directly, so the trivial input-to-loads order is satisfied.
